lead: Rajnath Singh is an Indian politician, born on 10 July 1951 in Chandauli district.
As of 2026, he is 75 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Rajnath facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Rajnath Singh — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajnath Singh was born on 10 July 1951 in Chandauli district, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Rambadan Singh and his mother, Gujrati Devi.
He received his education at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Gorakhpur University.

sections.heading: Rajnath Singh — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and physicist as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: Member of the Lok Sabha (2024–present). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.

sections.heading: Rajnath Singh — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Savitri Singh (married 1971).
He is a parent to Pankaj Singh, Neeraj Singh and Anamika Singh.
